title: Gameplay Encounter Viewport
objective: Teach the player to read pressure, route through cover, clear the wave, and claim a shortcut reward.
camera: third-person shoulder camera with top-down planning overlay

entities.name: Player Spawn
entities.notes: Safe spawn with the objective landmark visible.

entities.name: Readable Cover
entities.notes: Teaches the recovery rhythm before the first flank.

entities.name: Pressure Wave A
entities.notes: Two melee chargers plus one ranged telegraph unit.

entities.name: Shortcut Core
entities.notes: Unlocks the return path after encounter mastery.

entities.name: Hidden Cache
entities.notes: Rewards exploration without blocking the critical path.

terrainZones.name: Upper Cover Field
terrainZones.traversal: Dash-to-cover rhythm with one exposed commitment lane.
terrainZones.cover: Chest-high silhouettes break ranged pressure while keeping enemy telegraphs visible.
terrainZones.notes: Primary recovery pocket for the first pressure beat.

terrainZones.name: Lower Stealth Basin
terrainZones.traversal: Optional route favors crouch movement, audio reads, and cache discovery.
terrainZones.mood: Cooler low-light pocket that contrasts with the foundry heat above.
terrainZones.notes: Keeps stealth viable without deleting the critical-path combat lesson.

terrainZones.name: Foundry Hazard Pocket
terrainZones.traversal: Irregular heat pocket forces a readable detour instead of a straight-line sprint.
terrainZones.mood: Orange furnace glow should signal danger even when color assist is active.
terrainZones.notes: Polygon footprint captures the playable hazard edge for encounter tuning.

terrainPaintStrokes.name: Ash Safe Read
terrainPaintStrokes.notes: Subtle material paint teaches the safe route without turning the arena into a rail.

terrainPaintStrokes.name: Ember Danger Paint
terrainPaintStrokes.notes: Brush-like danger paint reinforces the polygon hazard edge with readable material language.

terrainSculptPatches.name: Molten Ridge Sculpt
terrainSculptPatches.meshIntent: Raised foundry slag ridge changes sightlines, camera occlusion risk, and cover value without blocking the critical path.
terrainSculptPatches.traversalImpact: Slope should be readable as dashable from the safe ash path and must not create hidden collision snags.
terrainSculptPatches.notes: Height sculpting patch for engine blockout: convert samples into a low-poly ridge or heightfield brush before combat greybox.

beats.name: Read Objective
beats.objective: Player sees destination and first cover.

beats.name: Pressure Window
beats.objective: Enemy composition teaches dodge, cover, and target priority.

beats.name: Reward Release
beats.objective: Shortcut opens and optional cache invites replay.

dynamicEvents.name: Storm Roll In
dynamicEvents.impact: Changes visibility and routes the player toward the shortcut.

spatialReads.name: Objective Sightline
spatialReads.sightline: The shortcut core is visible from spawn, framed between two cover silhouettes.
spatialReads.cover: Mid-cover breaks ranged pressure without hiding the objective.
spatialReads.chokepoint: The bridge into the final arena narrows movement for one pressure beat only.
spatialReads.stealthRoute: Lower route avoids the first wave but exposes the hidden cache risk.
spatialReads.traversalRhythm: Safe cover, exposed dash, recovery pocket, objective commit.
spatialReads.tensionSpacing: Thirty seconds of reading before the first overlapping hazard.

worldSimulation.ecosystem: Steam vents, storm visibility, and enemy patrols react to the foundry's heat cycle.
npcSchedules: Captain patrols the upper gantry before the player enters.
Support unit checks the hidden cache route after the storm roll-in.
factionTerritory: Ember Court controls the shortcut core.
Rebel scavengers contest the lower stealth route.
worldSimulation.weather: Storm state lowers long sightlines and makes audio cues more important.
worldSimulation.persistence: Unlocked shortcut and spent cache remain changed on return visits.
worldSimulation.destruction: Steam pipes can rupture into temporary cover denial, never permanent soft locks.
reactiveRules: If the player clears without alarms, patrol density drops on the return path.
If the captain retreats, faction reputation changes the next dialogue branch.

cameraPlan.framing: Keeps player, active threat, and next cover in frame during pressure beats.
cameraPlan.comfort: Camera shake and FOV pulse are reduced when accessibility assist is on.
cameraPlan.readability: Target lock never hides objective markers or enemy telegraphs.

cameraPlan.framing: Shows route, cover, and hazard timings without pausing enemy state.
cameraPlan.comfort: Overlay snaps smoothly with no spin transitions.
cameraPlan.readability: Color and icon shapes distinguish danger, reward, and stealth paths.

accessibilityNotes: Pair enemy telegraphs with audio cues and subtitle barks.
Do not rely only on red/green color feedback for danger and healing.
